name: pi-workflow
description: Claude Code-style workflow orchestration: an LLM-callable `workflow` tool that runs a deterministic JS script fanning out one-shot subagents via agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase()/log(), with a journal-backed resume, saved workflows (/workflows), a live progress tree above the editor, and an alt+w stop brake. Subagent tool calls are pi-safety gated over workflow:confirm-request.
